title: Heathrow passengers face disruption after flood restricts access
description:
Airport advises passengers travelling from terminals 2 and 3 to use rail and tube as pipe leak closes road

Heathrow airport has warned of disruption after flooding caused by a pipe leak restricted access to terminals 2 and 3.

Water in the central terminal area means anyone trying to travel to or from either terminal is unable enter by road. Passengers are being advised to travel by rail and tube instead. Access to the terminal car parks is also impeded, leaving passengers with parked cars unable to access them.
